Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
notes: Posted 26 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting': Ralltiir Operations ('Railter opts'), Boonta Eve Podrace, Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO'), Ralltiir ('Railter'), Tatooine: Podrace Arena ('Arena'), Start Your Engines! and Sebulba's Podracer ('sebulla's racer machine'); these count toward the 60 (total 60).

Posted 'boonta eve podracer' and 'Arena' dested the Dark Tatooine pages Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark) and Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark); 'Railter', 'spaceport city', 'forest', 'desert' and 'speeder bike' the Dark pages.
Posted 'docking bay' dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark): the Ralltiir objective deploys Spaceport sites and the strategy pulls the docking bay first turn.

Posted 'bossk in hound' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'zuckuss in his cripp' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'ig-88 in 2000' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'vaders stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'mara jade stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; '4-lom with rifle' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'aura sing' Aurra Sing.

Posted 'there is no try/op' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'set for stun combo' Control & Set For Stun; 'ghkk/combo' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'ommni box/combo' Ommni Box & It's Worse.
Posted 'defensive combo' dested Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch, the only Dark combo interrupt of the era with a 'Defensive' card.
Posted 'snoova/and or piet' names two alternative characters for one slot; it is printed as written.
Corporal Avarik is listed twice under characters (two separate lines); both are kept as posted.
